title: Charges & payments
pageDescription: A simple signed ledger: charges increase the balance, payments reduce it, and reversals or refunds preserve the audit trail.

mutability.superseded: This entry has already been corrected or reversed.
mutability.draftInvoice: This entry is on a draft invoice. Remove it from the draft before editing.
mutability.sentInvoice: This entry is protected by a sent or paid invoice. Void the invoice and reissue it to make a correction.
mutability.notFinanceManager: Only finance managers can change ledger entries.
mutability.unavailable: Edit and delete are unavailable because the server could not confirm this entry's mutability.

deletePayment.title: Delete this payment?
deletePayment.description: This records a signed reversal and keeps the original payment in the ledger. Use Record refund when money was actually returned.

refundPayment.title: Record a full refund?
refundPayment.description: This adds a separate outgoing payment and keeps the original payment in the audit trail.

reverseCharge.title: Reverse this charge?
reverseCharge.description: A new negative Charge for the same amount will be added. The original Charge remains visible.

deleteCharge.title: Delete this charge?
deleteCharge.description: This records a separate reversal and keeps the original charge visible in the ledger.

payment.lockedNotice: Successful and integration-locked payments are immutable. Record a refund instead.
payment.successStatusHint: A successful payment stays successful. Corrections are recorded as signed ledger events.
payment.memberValidation: Select an existing member from the list.
payment.revenueNotice: Recording a payment also records revenue by payment date.
payment.chargeTraceableHint: Search by description to select an older Charge. This is a traceable reference only; the balance always uses the full payment amount.
payment.notePlaceholder: Optional — what this payment was for

charge.title: Add manual charge
charge.memberValidation: Select an existing member from the list.
charge.reversalHint: Corrections are recorded with a separate negative reversal Charge.

memberLink.title: Link existing member
memberLink.memberValidation: Select an existing member from the list.

toasts.chargeLinkedError: This Charge is linked to an invoice or reversal and cannot be deleted.
toasts.paymentRefundedError: This payment already has a refund and cannot be deleted.
